name: What is the process for getting custom cabinets from Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting custom cabinets from Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision, needs, and budget. We then take precise measurements of your space. Following this, we develop detailed designs and material selections for your approval. Once finalized, our skilled craftsmen construct your cabinets in our workshop. Finally, we handle the professional installation in your home, ensuring a perfect fit and finish. We communicate regularly throughout each stage to keep you informed.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, measurement, design, construction, and professional installation by Frasheski Construction.
